title: Nauti Girl Excursions

services.name: sunset Martha's Vineyard
services.desc: Step aboard the Feelin’ Nauti, our custom 24' double-decker pontoon, for the ultimate island finale. As the day cools, set the mood with your favorite playlist on our premium Bluetooth system and sip a cocktail from the upper deck. Guided by USCG Master Captain Angie Fisher, you’ll cruise through the historic Edgartown Harbor toward the tranquil waters of Katama Bay. Along the way, Angie will share a piece of her heritage as you pass her father’s oyster farm and the wild shores of Chappaquiddick.
